overview: 今日专题“全球治理与外交”。共筛选 23 个高价值事件，重点关注中国相关进展、美国相关进展及全球外交、经济与安全动态。

items.title: 美國撤銷巴西大使簽證 兩國外交衝突何以加劇 ？ | 國際
items.titleZh: 美国撤销巴西大使签证，两国外交冲突何以加剧？
items.summaryZh: 美国撤销巴西大使签证的举动引发了外界对两国关系恶化的关注。此次外交冲突反映了双方在多项议题上的深层分歧。
items.whyImportant: 美巴外交关系的紧张可能对区域地缘政治产生连锁反应。

items.title: 大外交｜美国同时关闭5处使领馆 ， 背后是财政资源洗牌与霸权模式变迁 ？
items.titleZh: 大外交｜美国同时关闭5处使领馆，背后是财政资源洗牌与霸权模式变迁？
items.summaryZh: 美国近期关闭了5处使领馆，引发了外界对其外交战略调整的猜测。分析认为，这可能与财政资源重新分配及霸权模式的演变有关。
items.whyImportant: 美国外交布局的收缩可能预示着其全球战略重心的转移。

items.title: Nato to ‘urgently’ get air defences for Ukraine, as Zelenskyy warns of surge in Russian missile production
items.summary: After Ukraine failed to shoot down a single ballistic missile fired by Russia on Wednesday, the president urged allies to increase supplies of Patriot interceptors Nato is working to get Ukraine the air defences it “urgently needs”, its secretary general has said, after Kyiv failed to shoot down a single Russian missile in an attack on Wednesday, and as Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Moscow was seeking to significantly boost missile ⁠production ahead of winter. Speaking at a National Security and Defense Council meeting on winter resilience, the Ukrainian president did not rule out the idea that stalling missile supplies from western allies were “aimed at making Ukraine, so to speak, more willing to compromise” in peace talks with Russia. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 北约承诺“紧急”为乌克兰提供防空系统，泽连斯基警告俄罗斯导弹产量激增
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰在周三未能拦截任何一枚俄罗斯弹道导弹，总统泽连斯基敦促盟友增加爱国者拦截导弹的供应。北约秘书长表示正努力提供乌克兰“急需”的防空系统，同时泽连斯基警告称莫斯科正试图在冬季前大幅提高导弹产量。
items.whyImportant: 乌克兰防空能力的不足引发了对其冬季能源安全及和平谈判筹码的担忧。

items.title: Pregnant woman dead and toddler found unharmed after outback Queensland siege ends in apparent murder-suicide
items.summary: A 45-year-old man and 23-year-old woman were found dead in the Charleville home after a near eight-hour police siege Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A pregnant woman and a man have been found dead at a home in the outback Queensland town of Charleville, in an apparent murder-suicide after a protracted overnight standoff with police. Police confirmed on Thursday that a toddler, who was found unharmed, had been at the home during the eight-hour siege that began on Wednesday evening. Several streets in the remote town, 600km west of Toowoomba, were locked down by police after officers arrived at the property on King Street following reports of “a serious assault”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚昆士兰州发生疑似谋杀自杀案，一名孕妇死亡，一名幼儿获救
items.summaryZh: 在昆士兰州查尔维尔的一处住宅中，警方在长达八小时的对峙后发现了一名45岁男子和一名23岁孕妇的尸体。现场发现的一名幼儿未受伤害，警方初步判定这是一起谋杀自杀案件。
items.whyImportant: 这起发生在偏远地区的暴力事件引发了当地社区对家庭安全问题的关注。

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed’s Michigan primary victory is the latest win for progressives challenging establishment-backed Democrats – as it happened
items.summary: This live blog is now closed. Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate primary Sign up for the Breaking News US email A quick update on the marquee Democratic primary race for US Senate in Michigan. Haley Stevens is trailing Abdul El-Sayed by fewer than 15,000 votes, according the Associated Press, whose count the Guardian uses on election night. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德赢得密歇根州初选，进步派挑战建制派民主党人再下一城
items.summaryZh: 在密歇根州备受关注的民主党参议院初选中，阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德击败了海莉·史蒂文斯。这是进步派挑战建制派民主党人的最新胜利。
items.whyImportant: 此次选举结果显示了美国民主党内部进步派力量的上升趋势。

items.title: News live: Indigenous Olympian tells inquiry ‘racism, sexism, misogyny’ at Boxing Australia should be investigated
items.summary: Federal parliamentary inquiry into racism, hate and violence continues this week. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast A 60-year-old man has died after an alleged assault in Melbourne, where he was allegedly set upon by a group of youths. Victoria police said the man sustained critical injuries on 1 August after the group of young people allegedly attempted to steal items from a nearby store in the suburb of Sunshine. The victim allegedly came to the aid of a shop employee before he was attacked himself. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 新闻直播：原住民奥运选手要求调查澳大利亚拳击协会的“种族主义、性别歧视和厌女症”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚联邦议会正在对种族主义和暴力问题进行调查。与此同时，墨尔本一名60岁男子因试图阻止青少年盗窃而遭袭击身亡。
items.whyImportant: 体育界内部的歧视问题与社会治安恶化成为澳大利亚当前的舆论焦点。

items.title: 熊本はきょうも危険な暑さ予想 熱中症対策を 台風影響にも注意
items.summary: 先月、震度7の揺れを観測した地震で大きな被害のあった熊本県では、6日も気温が上がっていて、危険な暑さとなるおそれもあり、できるかぎりの熱中症対策を行ってください。また、台風13号の影響で風が強まる見込みで、気象庁は強風に注意するよう呼びかけています。
items.titleZh: 熊本今日预计仍有危险高温，需防范中暑及台风影响
items.summaryZh: 上月遭受地震重创的熊本县今日气温持续升高，存在中暑风险，气象部门呼吁民众采取防暑措施。此外，受第13号台风影响，当地预计将出现强风，需加强防范。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气叠加灾后重建压力，对当地民众的生命安全构成双重威胁。

items.title: Explosive-laden drone found at German airport hosting Ukrainian fleet
items.summary: German police raised the alarm at an airport overnight after an explosive-laden drone was found near a Ukrainian cargo plane and another aircraft collided with an unknown flying object nearby before landing safely. All flights to Leipzig-Halle airport were diverted for several hours from around midnight as police deployed a bomb-disposal robot to remove the detonator from the explosive in the drone The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) had been found on the tarmac. The airport in eastern Germany...
items.titleZh: 德国机场发现装有爆炸物的无人机，该机场曾接待乌克兰机队
items.summaryZh: 德国莱比锡-哈雷机场因发现一架载有爆炸物的无人机而暂停航班数小时。警方部署了排爆机器人处理该装置，同时另有一架飞机在降落前与不明飞行物发生碰撞。
items.whyImportant: 在敏感时期发生的机场安全事件引发了对航空安全及潜在破坏活动的担忧。

items.title: Man arrested at Trump’s California golf course wore earpiece and took photos, police say
items.summary: Jeanine John Taele faces new weapons charges as details of ‘suspicious’ behavior ahead of president’s visit emerge A California man who was arrested at Donald Trump’s Los Angeles-area golf course ahead of a presidential visit is facing more charges, as authorities released new details about the investigation. Authorities say federal agents first observed 38-year-old Jeanine John Taele near the golf grounds in Rancho Palos Verdes on 31 July, wearing an earpiece and capturing photographs and videos of security agents assessing the property. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 警方称一名男子在特朗普加州高尔夫球场被捕，当时佩戴耳机并进行拍摄
items.summaryZh: 一名38岁男子因在特朗普位于加州的高尔夫球场附近表现可疑被捕，当时他佩戴耳机并拍摄安保人员。该男子目前面临新的武器指控。
items.whyImportant: 针对前总统及现任总统候选人的安保威胁始终是美国社会高度关注的议题。

items.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial: toxicologist testifies about medications found in defendant’s blood
items.summary: Variety of prescriptions were found in blood of mother accused of strangling her three children, court hears Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email The trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman accused of killing her three children in January 2023, continued on Wednesday with a forensic toxicologist testifying to the variety and concentration of medications found in the defendant’s blood. Justin Brower, a forensic toxicologist with NMS Laboratories, testified that his lab examined the levels of four psychiatric medications detected in Clancy’s blood after she allegedly strangled her children and attempted to take her own life. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 林赛·克兰西谋杀案审判：毒理学家就被告血液中的药物成分作证
items.summaryZh: 在马萨诸塞州一名母亲被控杀害三名子女的审判中，法医毒理学家出庭作证。专家详细说明了被告血液中检测到的四种精神类药物的浓度。
items.whyImportant: 被告的精神状态及药物影响成为该案定罪的关键辩论点。

items.title: News Corp subscriptions fall in Australia as company takes aim at ‘slimy’ AI slop
items.summary: Chief executive Robert Thomson says ‘crass kleptomaniac’ AI companies are ‘in possession of stolen goods’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast News Corp has reported a slight slide in digital subscriptions at its Australian mastheads, erasing recent gains, among otherwise robust financials at the Rupert Murdoch-backed global conglomerate. Digital subscribers at News Corp Australia – a division that includes the Australian, the Daily Telegraph and the Herald Sun, among others – fell from 1,166,000 to 1,162,000 during the financial year, according to the company’s internal data published in its full year results on Thursday morning. items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻集团订阅量下降，公司抨击人工智能公司“窃取内容”
items.summaryZh: 新闻集团报告称其澳大利亚业务的数字订阅量出现小幅下滑。首席执行官罗伯特·汤姆森公开指责人工智能公司非法使用其新闻内容。
items.whyImportant: 传统媒体与人工智能公司在版权和内容价值方面的冲突日益加剧。

items.title: ‘Lyrical Maverick’ Peter Lai, who wrote multiple hits for Cantopop stars, dies at 76
items.summary: Legendary Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai Bei-dak, who wrote the lyrics to a string of hits for the city’s Cantopop stars in the 1980s, has died at the age of 76, triggering an outpouring of condolences from fans of “The Lyrical Maverick”. Sports commentator Eric Chung Chi-kwong, a close friend of Lai, announced his death on Wednesday. He told the media that Lai had moved into a nursing home earlier this year after suffering a stroke and collapsing at home. He remained bedridden until his...
items.titleZh: 曾为多位粤语流行歌手创作金曲的“词坛怪杰”黎彼得去世，享年76岁
items.summaryZh: 香港著名填词人黎彼得去世，享年76岁。他曾为80年代多位粤语流行歌手创作经典歌词，其离世引发了乐迷的广泛哀悼。
items.whyImportant: 黎彼得作为香港流行音乐黄金时代的代表人物，其离世标志着一个时代的落幕。

items.title: AI or real? BBC analyses viral China disaster videos
items.summary: As weather events become more extreme, fake videos are being shared rapidly online, and it’s causing real world problems in China.
items.titleZh: 人工智能还是真实影像？BBC分析中国灾难视频的真伪
items.summaryZh: 随着极端天气频发，网络上流传的虚假视频引发了社会混乱。BBC对此类视频进行了分析，探讨其对现实世界造成的负面影响。
items.whyImportant: AI生成内容的泛滥正在削弱公众对突发事件信息的信任度。

items.title: Singapore court jails Hong Kong mother, adult son for violent Changi clash
items.summary: A Singaporean court has jailed a Hong Kong mother and her adult son for up to six months following a chaotic clash at Changi Airport, during which the pair attacked a police officer and a bystander. Chan Sui-kwan, 65, was reportedly sentenced to six months’ imprisonment on Monday for voluntarily causing hurt to deter a public servant from the discharge of his duty, while her son, Chan Wing-kwan, 42, was handed a 10-day jail term for voluntarily causing hurt. The incident occurred on the...
items.titleZh: 新加坡法院判处香港母子入狱，因其在樟宜机场发生暴力冲突
items.summaryZh: 一对香港母子因在新加坡樟宜机场袭击警察和路人，分别被判处六个月和十天监禁。该事件在当地引发了对公共秩序的讨论。
items.whyImportant: 此案凸显了在国际旅行中遵守当地法律和维护公共秩序的重要性。

items.title: Hong Kong urged to be ‘super partner’ in businesses’ overseas expansion push
items.summary: Hong Kong should act as a “super partner” helping enterprises expand into Asean, Middle Eastern, Central Asian and European markets, as well as build an annual review into its first five-year plan, one of the city’s oldest and largest chambers of commerce has said. The suggestions are among 65 that the Chinese General Chamber of Commerce put forward to the government on Wednesday, covering Hong Kong’s maiden five-year plan and the city leader’s final policy address of his term. Jonathan Choi...
items.titleZh: 香港被敦促成为企业海外扩张的“超级联系人”
items.summaryZh: 香港中华总商会向政府提出65项建议，呼吁香港在企业进军东盟、中东及欧洲市场时发挥“超级联系人”作用。建议涵盖了香港首个五年规划及政策方针。
items.whyImportant: 香港在协助企业应对全球化挑战和拓展新兴市场方面扮演着关键角色。

items.title: What caused a near miss between 2 jets near Tokyo – and what can China learn?
items.summary: A near-miss on Tuesday involving an All Nippon Airways (ANA) plane coming dangerously close to another jet while approaching Tokyo’s Haneda Airport from Shanghai has thrown aviation safety back into focus – particularly, anti-collision technology and protocols – according to industry professionals based in China. While the intervention of one jet’s traffic collision avoidance system (TCAS) prevented contact between the two planes, analysts said there were lessons China could learn from the...
items.titleZh: 东京附近两架喷气式飞机险些相撞的原因及中国可借鉴的经验
items.summaryZh: 全日空一架客机在接近东京羽田机场时与另一架飞机发生近距离接触，幸亏防撞系统介入避免了事故。行业专家指出，中国航空业应从中吸取防撞技术和协议方面的经验。
items.whyImportant: 航空安全协议的完善对于保障日益繁忙的空中交通至关重要。

items.title: Copper floods US as traders try to get the jump on Trump tariffs, but ‘Taco’ trend looms
items.summary: Spurred by US President Donald Trump’s proposed new tariffs on cathode imports, copper shipments from across the globe are flooding into the United States. But analysts warn that should a so-called Taco scenario again unfold – as in, “Trump always chickens out” – copper prices in the US would likely fall in the short term. IHS Markit shipping data showed that more than 200,000 tonnes of copper landed in the US last month – a 12‑year high for monthly inflows. This was said to have pushed the...
items.titleZh: 铜矿涌入美国，交易员试图抢在特朗普关税政策前布局，但“塔科”风险隐现
items.summaryZh: 受特朗普拟议关税政策影响，全球铜矿大量涌入美国，上月进口量创下12年新高。分析师警告，若特朗普最终放弃关税政策，美国国内铜价可能面临短期下跌风险。
items.whyImportant: 贸易政策的不确定性正在扰乱大宗商品的全球供应链。

items.title: President Trump and Republicans Deliver Big Wins for the Silver State
items.summary: From the largest tax cut for working families in American history to the most secure border on record, Nevada is winning again under President Donald J. Trump and Republican leadership. items.titleZh: 特朗普总统与共和党人为内华达州带来重大胜利
items.summaryZh: 白宫声明称，在特朗普总统和共和党领导下，内华达州在减税、边境安全和能源开发方面取得了显著进展。政府强调这些政策为当地家庭带来了经济增长。
items.whyImportant: 该声明反映了共和党在关键摇摆州推行政策的政治叙事。

items.title: US-Japan trade thaw driven by shared yen for stronger currency
items.summary: A rare joint intervention to stabilise the yen has given US-Japan relations a near-term lift, according to analysts. But whether that goodwill endures depends on how long the currency’s rebound can survive mounting market and policy pressures. Friday’s operation, Washington’s first yen purchase since 1998, came after the Japanese currency had slumped to a four-decade low of almost 164 yen to the US dollar. The intervention briefly lifted the yen to a three-month high of 155.2 on Friday before it...
items.titleZh: 美日贸易缓和，源于双方对货币走强的共同渴望
items.summaryZh: 美日近期罕见联合干预汇市以稳定日元，改善了双边关系。然而，这种关系的持续性取决于日元反弹能否抵御市场和政策压力。
items.whyImportant: 货币政策的协调对美日经济稳定及双边外交关系具有重要意义。

items.title: Amid slowing hotpot growth in China, Haidilao takes on biggest American burger brands
items.summary: China’s largest hotpot chain Haidilao International Holding is aiming to further diversify its business with hamburger stores – following the example set by American brands like McDonald’s and KFC – and has also opened up more sushi stores to tap new growth drivers, as its core hotpot business shows slowing momentum. The country’s hamburger market is seeing intense competition, with US brand Five Guys opening its first two stores in Beijing on Monday. Hong Kong-listed Haidilao officially...
items.titleZh: 中国火锅市场增长放缓，海底捞进军美国汉堡品牌市场
items.summaryZh: 面对火锅业务增长放缓，中国海底捞正通过开设汉堡店和寿司店进行多元化经营。此举旨在通过模仿麦当劳等国际品牌的模式寻找新的增长点。
items.whyImportant: 餐饮巨头的多元化转型反映了中国消费市场竞争加剧的现状。

items.title: Erica Schwartz confirmed as new CDC chief amid US agency turmoil
items.summary: US public health agency faces toughest test as Schwartz takes charge amid political pressure and public health crises.
items.titleZh: 埃里卡·施瓦茨被确认为新任美国疾控中心主任，机构正处于动荡之中
items.summaryZh: 在美国疾控中心面临政治压力和公共卫生危机的背景下，埃里卡·施瓦茨被任命为新任主任。她将领导该机构应对严峻的考验。
items.whyImportant: 疾控中心领导层的变动对美国公共卫生政策的执行具有深远影响。

items.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan primary in jolt to Democrats
items.summary: The Democratic Party’s progressive ⁠wing scored a high-profile victory on Wednesday when Abdul El-Sayed won the party’s US Senate nomination ⁠in Michigan, giving its anti-establishment message a boost ahead of November’s midterm elections. El-Sayed, a doctor whose campaign focused on healthcare, the economy and an end to unconditional military aid to Israel, was the first progressive to win a statewide primary in a state that US President Donald Trump carried in 2024. He will face Republican...
items.titleZh: 进步派阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德赢得密歇根州初选，震动民主党
items.summaryZh: 民主党进步派在密歇根州参议院初选中取得重大胜利，阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德凭借医疗保健和经济议题胜出。这一结果增强了反建制派在选举中的声势。
items.whyImportant: 进步派的崛起可能改变民主党在未来选举中的政策重心。

items.title: Zelenskyy calls for more air defences as Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 17
items.summary: Ukraine shoots down most drones but no ballistic missiles in overnight attack that mainly targeted civilian facilities Volodymyr Zelenskyy has blamed allies for not delivering air defences fast enough after Ukraine failed to shoot down a single Russian missile in a deadly overnight attack that killed at least 17 people and ⁠injured dozens more. Preliminary data from the Ukrainian air force showed its defences shot down 98 of the 115 drones fired by Russia overnight, but no ballistic missiles. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基呼吁加强防空，俄罗斯对基辅的袭击造成至少17人死亡
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰在夜间袭击中未能拦截任何弹道导弹，导致至少17人死亡。泽连斯基指责盟友交付防空系统速度过慢，尽管乌军拦截了大部分无人机。
items.whyImportant: 防空能力的短板直接导致了乌克兰平民伤亡的增加，加剧了对援助效率的质疑。
